column4: kapag matagal ang processing: email sending, report generation, image processing — hindi dapat mag-antay ang user
gamitin ang Redis + Bull, RabbitMQ, o SQS — i-produce ang jobs, i-consume ng workers
pag-handle ng maraming items sa iisang run: bulk email, data migration, report generation
i-retry nang may backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s — pagkatapos ng max retries, i-dead letter queue
gamitin ang dashboard para makita ang queue length, failed jobs, processing time
